name: Faurya
author: faurya

sections.description:
Faurya is a lightweight, privacy-friendly website analytics plugin for WordPress. It helps site owners add Faurya analytics to their WordPress site without manually editing theme files, so setup stays simple and tracking can be managed from one place.

To use the plugin, connect your WordPress site with your Faurya API key. The API key is available inside your Faurya dashboard under the Site Settings tab. Once connected, the plugin adds the Faurya tracking script to your public WordPress pages using WordPress’ standard script loading system.

This plugin acts as a connector for the Faurya analytics service. A Faurya account and site are required to use the tracking features.

Learn more about the WordPress integration at https://www.faurya.com/integrations/wordpress.

Features

  • Lightweight WordPress integration for Faurya analytics.
  • Adds the Faurya tracking script without manual theme editing.
  • Easy setup using your Faurya API key.
  • API key available from the Faurya Site Settings tab.
  • Connection status shown directly in WordPress admin.
  • Refresh and disconnect actions from the plugin settings screen.
  • Remote disconnect support from Faurya when available.
  • Keeps visitor analytics out of the WordPress database.
  • Clean uninstall removes stored Faurya connection settings.

How it works

  1. Create or open your site in Faurya.
  2. Open the Site Settings tab in Faurya.
  3. Copy your Faurya API key.
  4. Open Settings -> Faurya in WordPress.
  5. Paste the API key and connect the site.
  6. Faurya tracking is added to your public WordPress pages.

Useful links

  • WordPress integration: https://www.faurya.com/integrations/wordpress
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.faurya.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://www.faurya.com/terms-of-services
  • Data Processing Agreement: https://www.faurya.com/data-processing-agreement

Privacy

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the external Faurya analytics service at https://www.faurya.com. No connection request is made until a site administrator enters the Faurya API key and submits the settings form.

During setup and status checks, the plugin may send your WordPress site URL, Faurya API key, and plugin version to Faurya. After connection, the Faurya tracking script may collect website analytics according to your Faurya account configuration and Faurya service terms.

Please review the Faurya Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Data Processing Agreement for details about how Faurya handles data.

Support

For plugin support, use the WordPress.org support forum for Faurya. For questions about your Faurya account, site setup, or analytics data, contact Faurya directly.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Search for “Faurya” and click Install Now, or upload the plugin ZIP file.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Settings -> Faurya.
  5. Enter your Faurya API key.
  6. Click Connect.
  7. Confirm that the connection status shows as connected.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Faurya account?

Yes. This plugin connects WordPress to the Faurya analytics service. You need a Faurya account and site before tracking can be enabled.

Where do I find my Faurya API key?

Log in to Faurya, open the site you want to connect, and copy the API key from the Site Settings tab.

Does this plugin edit my theme files?

No. The Faurya tracking script is added through WordPress’ script loading system. Your theme files are not modified.

Does this plugin store visitor analytics in WordPress?

No. The plugin stores connection settings needed to add the tracking script, but it does not store visitor analytics reports in your WordPress database.

When does tracking start?

Tracking starts after a site administrator enters valid Faurya connection details and the plugin receives a tracking script URL from Faurya.

Can I disconnect Faurya later?

Yes. You can disconnect from the WordPress settings page. When supported by your Faurya setup, Faurya can also send a secure remote disconnect request to disable tracking.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivation disables the tracking script while keeping the saved connection settings. If you reactivate the plugin, tracking can resume without re-entering the API key.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

Uninstalling deletes the stored Faurya API key, site ID, domain, tracking script URL, remote token, and connection state from WordPress.

Does it work with caching plugins?

The tracking script is loaded through standard WordPress frontend script loading and should work with typical WordPress caching setups. If you use full-page caching, clear your cache after connecting or disconnecting.

  • Connect WordPress to Faurya analytics.
  • Add Faurya tracking script to public WordPress pages.
  • Show connection status in WordPress admin.
  • Refresh and disconnect from the settings page.
  • Support secure remote disconnect.
  • Remove stored connection data on uninstall.
